description: This file defines the abstract base class 'Grain' and its generic subclass for Orleans grains, including constructors, properties, lifecycle management, and migration support.

classes.name: Grain
classes.description: Abstract base class for all Orleans grain classes, providing core lifecycle and runtime interaction functionalities.

classes.name: Grain<TGrainState>
classes.description: Generic subclass of Grain that manages persistent state with lifecycle support and migration capabilities.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.description: Registers a timer callback to be invoked periodically, marked as obsolete.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Marks the grain for deactivation after the current method completes.

methods.name: MigrateOnIdle
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous migration of the grain to another location.

methods.name: DelayDeactivation
methods.description: Delays the deactivation of the grain for a specified duration.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Virtual method called after grain activation, can be overridden for custom behavior.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Virtual method called before grain deactivation, can be overridden for cleanup.
